item.title: Verbose beta 313
item.description:
Typing help, one search, and one Stop

Mac

  • The toolbar's search field opens the same panel as ⌘K, and the Ask page shows it too. Recordings and matching lines show in the panel, so the Library stays put while you type. ↓ and ↑ choose a result and Return opens it.
  • ⌘F finds words in the Cleaned and Summary tabs too, without switching to Original. Matches show in butter, and ⌘G and ⇧⌘G step through them.
  • The Settings window's sidebar is the system's, with ↑ and ↓ to move between panes.
  • The welcome tour opens on drawings of Capture, Refine, and Understand. Each color on the ways step keeps one meaning.
  • Stop is the same persimmon button in the app, on the Lock Screen, and on the watch. Red now only marks Record.
  • Home's Record card, tiles, cards, and recent rows highlight under the pointer. Every shortcut shows as the same keycap, at 12 points or larger.
  • Menus and toolbars use Verbose's own glyphs, and sheets close with the X at top right. Cards on the older Settings pages take the same rounder corners.
  • Each welcome tour step scrolls when it's tall, so its buttons stay in reach. Live captions on the Mac open at the height for their text size, on screen.

Also on iPhone

  • The Verbose keyboard fixes a misspelled word when you type a space. Delete puts it back.
  • Three words above the keys: what you typed, the correction, and a completion.
  • Hold a letter for its accents. Spanish adds ñ; French gets AZERTY and German QWERTZ.
  • Hold the space bar, then drag left or right to move the cursor.
  • Type in the Library's field, then choose Search or Ask under it.
  • Record, Dictate, and New thought in Control Center show when they're on.
  • The Record widget shows a running recording's time and Stop.
  • While your iPhone records, the Watch's Smart Stack shows the time and your voice.
  • Always On dims a recording with the bars held still. Record fits watch corner slots.
